paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise (attribution deferred): some being before which nothing is in time is in potency in some respect, as in the Night or chaos cosmogonies of Metaphysics XII.6 1071b26-28 or any world whose first being is changeable. Aristotle's Theta.8 claim that act is prior in time in species, though not in number, is a rival to it.
